slides.texte_overlay:
Little Things That Make People
Trust You From Day One

1. Don't check your phone
while they talk

• Not even a glance.
Attention is respect.

2. Be where you said,
when you said

• Every time.
Trust is built on boring moments.

3. Give things back
before they ask

• The book, the charger,
the money. Without a reminder.

4. Stay calm when
things go wrong

• People trust the man
who doesn't panic.

5. Tell the truth when
a lie would be easier

• Once they see it,
they never forget it.

6. Admit what you
don't know

• Then go learn it.
Honest and curious beats
pretending every time.
